name: Anneliese Weber
bio:
Anneliese's career began in the fast-paced world of telecommunications, where she quickly established herself as a problem-solver with a knack for streamlining complex systems. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, she transitioned to the racing world after recognizing the need for robust and innovative IT solutions to support the data-driven nature of modern racing. 

At Dick Johnson Racing, Anneliese is responsible for ensuring the team's IT infrastructure is operating at peak performance. Her demanding nature pushes her team to deliver cutting-edge solutions, while her focus on clear communication and efficient processes ensures that the rest of the team can focus on track performance. Anneliese is not afraid to challenge the status quo and is always looking for innovative ways to leverage technology to gain a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle waves.
physical.description: A commanding presence with sharp features and an air of quiet competence.
